name: Festival Crowd
desc: Backlit rows of silhouetted festival-goers that jump on the beat while a hands-up wave ripples across them and phone lights twinkle in the haze.

n.doc: number of figures (front-biased across depth rows)

scale.doc: figure size vs design (front row ~0.32*min-dim tall at 1)

energy.doc: jump height + arm-wave amplitude + audio gain

speed.doc: beats-relative rate multiplier for wave & jumps

density.doc: floating phone-light / spark motes among the crowd

spread.doc: horizontal fill of the crowd across the frame

x.doc: crowd anchor x as canvas fraction

y.doc: front-row feet line as canvas fraction

style.doc: render philosophy: mass silhouette / infrared false-color / 2-ink halftone print / X-ray skeletal line

act.doc: multi-minute energy program: full wave / gentle sway / moshing
